root_cause: DubboProtocol.getInvoker() lacks a null check on the PATH_KEY attachment AND when path == null (e.g. because a non-Serializable request parameter causes decode failure) that null flows through ProtocolUtils.serviceKey into GroupServiceKeyCache.getServiceKey() where it is used as a ConcurrentHashMap key, so a misleading NullPointerException is thrown instead of a RemotingException.
reasoning_trace: Read the vulnerable DubboProtocol.getInvoker() implementation and the patch context.

reasoning_trace.result: Located getInvoker(): path is read from the invocation attachment and later passed into serviceKey without a null guard.

reasoning_trace: Confirmed the failing condition: inv.getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert(PATH_KEY) == null, and that null is used as the serviceName for serviceKey lookup.

reasoning_trace.result: ProtocolUtils.serviceKey passes serviceName through unchecked to GroupServiceKeyCache.
GroupServiceKeyCache.getServiceKey uses serviceName as a key in a ConcurrentHashMap, so a null serviceName causes a raw NullPointerException.

reasoning_trace: Concluded the NPE is misleading; the patch adds an explicit path == null check in getInvoker() that throws RemotingException before the map lookup.
